modern: You can remove from your way many useless things among those which disturb you, for they lie entirely in your opinion; and you will then gain ample space for yourself by grasping the whole universe in your mind, and by contemplating the eternity of time, and observing the rapid change of each separate thing, how short is the time from birth to dissolution, and the boundless time before birth as well as the equally boundless time after dissolution!
original: Thou canst remove out of the way many useless things among those which disturb thee, for they lie entirely in thy opinion; and thou wilt then gain for thyself ample space by comprehending the whole universe in thy mind, and by contemplating the eternity of time, and observing the rapid change of every several thing, how short is the time from birth to dissolution, and the illimitable time before birth as well as the equally boundless time after dissolution!

explained.summary: Much of what bothers you exists only in your own opinion, and you can clear it away. That frees up room to think on a bigger scale: the whole universe, the endless stretch of time, how quickly each thing changes, how short the time is between birth and death, and how vast the stretches before and after. Against that backdrop, most worries lose their grip.
explained.today: The awkward thing you said at a party, or the slight in a group chat, feels huge at two in the morning. Thinking for a moment about the age of the stars or how many people have lived before you can give the worry its proper, tiny size.
